ValidationRule.description: The Pending Reason 'Internal Response' or 'Supervisor' needs to be selected for Status 'Internal - On Hold' The epic for reference #1008 Contact is Required #26422
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $RecordType.Name = 'Global Service Case', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Internal - On Hold'), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(NAS_Pending_Reason__c, 'Internal Response')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(NAS_Pending_Reason__c, 'Supervisor')) ),
AND(ISBLANK(ContactId),NOT(Is_IM_Employee__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To change the case status to 'Internal - On Hold', the Pending Reason must be either 'Internal Response' or 'Supervisor' and a Contact is mandatory.
